Only the main column; sidebar and composer keep the theme solid color

Background is off; these styles apply once you pick a source.

Enlarges text (UI copy and message body) without touching layout geometry — geometric zoom fights the host’s sidebar drag and is banned by the gate
Line height, paragraph spacing and heading scale only — font size stays with the row above
Derived from the theme brand and body colours — follows theme/accent changes

Icon buttons get a 44px floor for touch; layout widens slightly
Empty = 920 px by default (narrows automatically on small windows); enter 640–1600 to override. Only the width variable changes, never layout
Lists only fonts shipped with the plugin; an unavailable family never silently falls back
Element looks only: heading size, code block, table, quote

Card adds a background and radius so the block lifts off the text
